notes: The frozen R01 submission, evidence SHA-256/Git blob, exact 38-path candidate scope, two-path submission projection, linear ancestry, generated Core contract, native supervisor allowlist, and disclosed pre-existing quality debt authenticate. Selected service, SQLite, generated-client, desktop, native, and governance checks pass. Approval remains unavailable because persisted attention/blocked/skipped heads are projected as an unrecoverable completed workflow; revisitation accepts a still-current pass and cannot select a completed earlier stage while another stage is current; idempotent replay returns mutable present state rather than the original command result; accepted profile migrations record impacts without materializing the accepted stage disposition under the new selection; completion accepts arbitrary same-project aggregate revisions as evidence; the progress service does not authenticate the full canonical Intent/activation/migration authority; and late renderer command/support responses can cross project/context boundaries.

findings.title: Attention, blocked, and skipped heads become an unrecoverable false-completion Project Home state
findings.reproduction: At candidate cd508bbf4c80ceedca13eb1e3364a1ba58480318, start systematic-review.default and mark intent-contract-1 attention-required. After reload, workflow_progress.py:476-539 computes current=null, bootstrapRequired=false and a completed-history recommendation because _current_primary excludes the attention head. ProjectHomeWorkspace.tsx:73-100 defines that combination as complete, renders 'Workflow complete', and has no resume path; WorkflowProgressAction at models.py:666-674 exposes no resume/reopen/make-current action. The same defect follows block, and skip leaves a mid-sequence optional stage without making its successor current. Linear profiles are permanently stranded and the UI misstates governed status.
findings.required_remediation: Define and implement explicit researcher-controlled recovery/continuation semantics for every accepted non-current head: Project Home must project attention, blocked, and skipped truthfully, preserve rationale/history, and offer only authorized resume/reopen or successor transitions with exact selection/head CAS. A skip that authorizes sequence continuation must atomically make the next stage current. Add real-SQLite restart/replay tests and renderer/browser tests for attention, blocked, optional skip, final completion, both linear/revisitable profiles, and prove background jobs cannot cause any transition.

findings.title: Revisit accepts a current unevidenced pass and rejects an authorized completed earlier-stage revisit
findings.reproduction: workflow_progress.py:606-616 and :641-696 select the current head as a revisit source and only reject when a different stage is current. The existing test at tests/service/test_workflow_progress.py:293-310 therefore starts a profile and immediately revisits its still-current first stage, appending pass 2 without completion, skip, stale state, or evidence. Conversely, after completing stage 1, stage 2 becomes current and an explicit revisit of completed stage 1 is rejected at :643-644. This differs from the task transition authority at CAP-03.S06.T04.task-start.md:49 and does not provide useful cyclical earlier-stage navigation.
findings.required_remediation: Permit revisit only from an exact completed, skipped, or stale source head in a revisitable profile; deny current/in-progress/attention/blocked sources. Define and atomically preserve the displaced current-stage truth when revisiting an earlier completed stage, append pass+1 to the same stage aggregate without erasing either history, and retain linear denial. Add exact transition-matrix, current-earlier-stage, CAS-conflict, restart, and history tests; replace the current-source test with an explicit denial.

findings.title: Exact idempotent replay returns mutable present projection instead of the committed command result
findings.reproduction: workflow_progress.py:580-597 authenticates the idempotency record but then reads every current state and returns _projection(selection, states, ...). In a real SQLite replay, start initially returns intent-contract-1/revision A; after completing it, byte-identical replay of start with the same actor/key returns search-studio-1/revision B. If the workflow selection changed, :586-591 can reject the already committed command before replay. resultRevisionIds stored at repositories.py:1398-1423 are only checked for continued presence and are not used to reconstruct the original result.
findings.required_remediation: Make same actor/key/command replay return the exact immutable original response authority and projection independent of later stage, staleness, or selection changes, while a changed command still conflicts. Persist or deterministically reconstruct the command-bound response from its exact result revisions and selection/staleness witness, and evaluate an authenticated existing replay before mutable current-selection preconditions. Add post-advance, post-staleness, post-profile-change, restart, response-loss, and changed-payload tests.

findings.title: Accepted profile migration records prior impacts but does not materialize the accepted stage disposition
findings.reproduction: research_intents.py:686-754 binds exact prior primary heads and :806-831 writes their retain/map/stale/review/drop dispositions into the new selection. _workflow_authority_mutation at :839-916 passes old stage rows only as expected_stage_states for CAS; it appends no new-selection stage state. The real-path test at tests/service/test_workflow_progress.py:370-395 consequently expects the changed profile to reload with bootstrapRequired=true and current=null even though priorStageStates names the accepted retained/mapped head. The write is atomic, but the approved migration result is not materialized and workflow position is reset.
findings.required_remediation: Within the same Intent/selection transaction and exact old-stage CAS, append the new-selection stage successors required by every accepted disposition, with exact predecessor/cause/migration references and an unambiguous current/review projection; preserve all old history. Any invalid mapping, fault, or race must roll back Intent, selection, migration, decisions, stage successors, provenance, and outbox together. Add retain/map/stale/review/drop, legacy-no-state, restart, injected-fault, and concurrent-head-change tests.

findings.title: Stage completion accepts an arbitrary same-project aggregate revision as evidence
findings.reproduction: repositories.py:1194-1236 resolves a supplied UUID in aggregate_revisions by project and revision ID, hashes a summary containing aggregateKind, but never constrains that kind or validates a stage completion evidence contract. A legitimate aggregate_kind=document revision is accepted by workflow_progress.py:646-660 and produces a completed stage. Thus exact project ownership prevents cross-project substitution but not evidence-authority substitution within the project.
findings.required_remediation: Authorize explicit evidence/output aggregate kinds and any required knowledge/rights state for each completion contract before hashing the exact immutable revision; reject all other aggregate kinds even when UUID/project/hash are valid. Add per-kind substitution tests, cross-project denial, duplicate/missing/stale evidence cases, response-loss replay, and real SQLite restart proof.

findings.title: Workflow progress bypasses canonical Intent and migration authority validation
findings.reproduction: workflow_progress.py:234-255 decodes each selection, verifies its self-hash/revision, and checks contiguous numbers only. It does not apply research_intents.py:1130-1279, which authenticates the activation witness and approved catalog/guidance hashes, exact parentSelection chain, accepted migration and decision resolution, canonical stored Intent reference, selector/actor identity, and profile/project equality. Nor does the progress route compare selection.projectId with its routed manifest project. A retained-valid-hash one-field substitution can therefore remain a valid portable selection while changing the principal or provenance authority consumed by progress.
findings.required_remediation: Share one canonical workflow-authority validator between Intent and progress and bind it to the routed manifest project plus the exact stored Intent history. Progress reads and commands must fail closed for missing/substituted activation witness, project, selector, Intent reference, parent, migration, decision, catalog/guidance hash, or stage selection reference. Add retained-valid-hash one-field mutation tests and exact pre-T02 compatibility/corruption fixtures at the real SQLite and generated API boundaries.

findings.title: Late workflow commands and parallel reads can cross renderer project/authority boundaries
findings.reproduction: ApplicationRuntime.tsx:583-632 captures a project/progress for start/revisit but applies success, failure, announcement, and busy-state effects without checking the live project or request generation. The open-supporting path at :634-675 does the same. Switch from project A to B while an A command is delayed and release A last: applyWorkflowProgress can replace B progress/select B UI from A stage data, or an A error can clear/set B state. The loader generation-guards only its separate reads at :488-529; progress exposes selection but not its exact canonical Intent revision, so parallel catalog/Intent/progress reads cannot prove one coherent SQLite authority snapshot. The renderer also recreates supporting return locally after success instead of binding the server supportingHandoff revision/expiry.
findings.required_remediation: Bind every command/support request and every success, failure, finally, announcement, and return-context mutation to the initiating project ID/root, selection/head witness, and live request generation. Discard stale A results after A-to-B and A-to-B-to-A replacement. Return or read one coherent Core Project Home authority snapshot that binds exact Intent, selection, progress, stale-output, and supporting-handoff revision/expiry, and make the renderer honor that server witness. Add delayed start, revisit, and supporting success/error browser tests plus same-profile mid-read substitution and expired-handoff denial.
